messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected - NLB target health flapping + connection resets in euc1-b (affecting ingress in that AZ). Paging on-call (sarah_oncall) at 1854998123.

sarah_oncall: on it, joining bridge now. seeing alarm: NLB_ConnReset_Rate spiking to ~40/min for target group tg-ingress-euc1b.

raj_neteng: looks like a short-time window of packet loss in euc1-b from the cloud provider - their console shows 15% packet drops on AZ uplink for that placement. filing with provider.

mike_sre: incoming customer reports of increased 5xx for deployments in euc1. error sample from envoy logs: ```"upstream reset_before_response_started"``` and `503 upstream connect error`.

julia-cs: two customers reported errors in EU region, one on staging, one on prod, both say failed requests ~20-30% last 7m. I'm messaging affected accounts.

alex_product: what's the blast radius? is this only NLB->ingress in that AZ or cross-AZ?

raj_neteng: initial traceroutes show asymmetric routing for euc1-b; a subset of hosts dropping during CTL window. Targets in euc1-a/c look fine. Seems localized to euc1-b ToR cluster.

incident-bot: Runbook: NETWORK-LB-01 recommended mitigations: 1) shift traffic away from affected AZ, 2) update LB target weights, 3) enable fallback route in route53 (if configured).

sarah_oncall: acting on 1/ then 2/. I'm going to reduce NLB target weight for tg-ingress-euc1b to 0. Will patch Route53 TTL if needed. Posting commands I'm running: 
```aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:...:tg-ingress-euc1b --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:aws:...:listener --default-actions '[{"Type":"forward","TargetGroupArn":"arn:aws:...:tg-ingress-euc1a","Order":1}]' --region eu-central-1```

mike_sre: holding canary for 60s. switching traffic now. expect some in-flight resets to surface.

(2m later)
sarah_oncall: changed weights -> euc1b weight -> 0, euc1a/c increased. Monitoring. NLB health checks show targets in euc1b still flapping but traffic reduced.

raj_neteng: provider confirms they observed uplink issue and are routing a hardware swipe. ETA 12-15m for full remediation. They asked us to keep traffic off the affected AZ while they replace fabric.

julia-cs: updated customers. one asked for ETA and whether we did failover — told them we shifted traffic to other AZs and they're seeing improvement.

alex_product: any downstream rollback needed? feature flags still on.

mike_sre: no rollback. this is infra-level. suggest setting the autoscaling target for ingress stacks in euc1 to prefer healthy AZs; also we'll add a temporary routing rule to avoid euc1b for 20m.

incident-bot: Note: deploy-bot detected a continuous deployment in progress in eu-central-1 2m before incident. Blocking further rollouts to euc1-b until mitigated.

deploy-bot: automatic pause applied to rollout id=deploy-4591 for eu-central-1.

raj_neteng: as extra protection, I'm updating NLB cross-zone load balancing to on for these TGs (so remaining healthy targets can receive all traffic). Command: `aws elbv2 modify-load-balancer-attributes --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:...:nlb-ingress --attributes Key=load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled,Value=true`

(5m later)
sarah_oncall: client-side error rate dropped from 22% -> 3% after weight shift and cross-zone enable. latency back to normal for most customers. leaving euc1b targets drained.

mike_sre: collecting packet captures and envoy partial request traces from the affected nodes for postmortem. saving `tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 -w /tmp/euc1b-reset.pcap` and envoy `admin/requests?limit=200`.

raj_neteng: provider now marking fabric as replaced for the ToR cluster; they request we slowly bring targets back to service and observe.

sarah_oncall: reintroducing euc1b targets gradually: set weight 10% -> 30% -> 60% over 5-min windows. watching NLB_ConnReset and backend_5xx.

(10m later)
sarah_oncall: after gradual comeback, metrics stable and connection resets returned to baseline. provider says hardware swap completed.

julia-cs: customers acknowledged recovery, one requested SLA note. I'm opening support cases to follow up.

alex_product: thanks all. action items for post-incident: 1) add automatic AZ-avoidance when provider reports uplink drops, 2) add playbook snippet to toggle cross-zone LB, 3) improve alerting to correlate NLB resets + provider uplink alarms.

mike_sre: agree. I'll file a postmortem and include packet captures + timeline. tagging raj and sarah for network & oncall notes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 1854998680. Summary: transient provider uplink failure in euc1-b caused elevated connection resets and 5xx. Mitigation: drained euc1-b targets, enabled cross-zone balancing, paused rollouts, and gradually restored after provider hardware swap.

sarah_oncall: handoff to next oncall (mike_sre) for postmortem follow-up. leaving bridge. :white_check_mark:
